capital.zh: 布路沙布逻（白沙瓦）；秣菟罗

summary.en: Founded by Yuezhi clans who had settled in Bactria, the Kushan Empire spanned Central Asia and north India, linked the Silk Road to the Indian Ocean trade and fostered Gandhara and Mathura Buddhist art.
summary.zh: 贵霜帝国由定居大夏的月氏部落建立，疆域横跨中亚和北印度，连接丝绸之路与印度洋贸易，并孕育了犍陀罗和秣菟罗佛教艺术。

sources.title: János Harmatta (ed.), History of Civilizations of Central Asia, vol. II (UNESCO, 1994)

note: Kushan regnal dates depend on the debated date of Kanishka’s accession (here c. 127, after Falk 2001).

name.zh: 百乘王朝（娑多婆诃王朝）

capital.zh: 普拉蒂什塔纳（派坦）；阿默拉沃蒂

summary.en: The Satavahanas ruled the Deccan from Pratishthana and later the Krishna delta, issuing bilingual coins, patronising Buddhist sites such as Amaravati and Karla and contesting western India with the Shaka Kshatrapas.
summary.zh: 百乘王朝以普拉蒂什塔纳为中心统治德干，后期重心移至克里希纳河三角洲；他们发行双语钱币，护持阿默拉沃蒂、卡尔拉等佛教圣地，并与塞种西部总督争夺西印度。

sources.title: Upinder Singh, A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India (2008)

note: The “long chronology” (from c. 230 BCE, used by Wikidata) competes with a short one starting in the 1st century BCE; early reign dates are very uncertain.

summary.en: From Pataliputra the Guptas united most of north India; their era is remembered for Sanskrit literature (Kalidasa), mathematics (Aryabhata), temple architecture and Nalanda, before Hun invasions and regional revolts broke the empire.
summary.zh: 笈多王朝以华氏城为中心统一北印度大部，以梵语文学（迦梨陀娑）、数学（阿耶波多）、神庙建筑和那烂陀寺著称，后因嚈哒（白匈奴）入侵和地方叛离而瓦解。

sources.title: Upinder Singh, A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India (2008)

note: The end date (c. 550) is conventional; Gupta rulers persisted locally into the late 6th century.

summary.en: The Pallavas of Kanchipuram dominated the Tamil north, fought long wars with the Chalukyas of Badami and pioneered Dravidian stone architecture at Mamallapuram before being supplanted by the Cholas.
summary.zh: 甘吉布勒姆的帕拉瓦王朝称雄泰米尔北部，与巴达米的遮娄其王朝长期交战，并在马马拉普拉姆开创达罗毗荼石构建筑，后被朱罗王朝取代。

name.zh: 那罗僧诃跋摩二世（罗阇僧诃）

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, A History of South India, 4th ed. (1975)

note: Early Pallava chronology (3rd–6th c.) is poorly known.

summary.en: Ruling the western Deccan from Vatapi, the early Chalukyas reached their height under Pulakeshin II, who stopped Harsha on the Narmada; their temples at Aihole, Badami and Pattadakal shaped Deccan architecture.
summary.zh: 早期遮娄其王朝以伐陀毗为都统治德干西部，在补罗稽舍二世时达到鼎盛，曾于讷尔默达河击退戒日王；其在艾霍莱、巴达米和帕塔达卡尔的神庙深刻影响了德干建筑。

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, A History of South India, 4th ed. (1975)

capital.zh: 坦贾武尔；恒伽贡达朱罗补罗

summary.en: An ancient Tamil lineage revived by Vijayalaya in the 9th century, the Cholas built an empire over south India and Sri Lanka, projected naval power into Southeast Asia and left monumental temples and a rich bronze tradition.
summary.zh: 朱罗是古老的泰米尔王族，9世纪由维阇耶拉耶复兴，建立起囊括南印度和斯里兰卡的帝国，海上力量远及东南亚，留下宏伟的神庙和精美的青铜造像传统。

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, The Cōḻas, 2nd ed. (1955)

note: The span follows Wikidata (from the Sangam-age Cholas, c. 300 BCE); the imperial Chola state ran from 848 to 1279.

capital.zh: 华氏城；后为高达、蒙吉尔

summary.en: Elected king by Bengal’s chiefs around 750, Gopala founded a Buddhist dynasty that ruled Bengal and Bihar, patronised Nalanda and founded Vikramashila, and spread Mahayana and Vajrayana Buddhism to Tibet and Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 约750年孟加拉诸首领推举瞿波罗为王，其建立的佛教王朝统治孟加拉与比哈尔，护持那烂陀并创建超戒寺，将大乘和金刚乘佛教传播到西藏与东南亚。

sources.title: Upinder Singh, A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India (2008)

note: Pala regnal years are approximate.

summary.en: Overthrowing the Chalukyas in 753, the Rashtrakutas made the Deccan a great power that raided Kannauj and the Tamil south; they carved the Kailasa temple at Ellora, and Arab travellers counted their king among the world’s greatest.
summary.zh: 罗湿陀罗拘陀王朝于753年推翻遮娄其王朝，使德干成为强国，曾北袭曲女城、南侵泰米尔地区；他们开凿了埃洛拉的凯拉萨神庙，阿拉伯旅行者将其国王列为世界最伟大的君主之一。

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, A History of South India, 4th ed. (1975)

summary.en: Five successive dynasties—Mamluk, Khalji, Tughluq, Sayyid and Lodi—ruled from Delhi, resisting the Mongols and at their height under Muhammad bin Tughluq reaching almost the whole subcontinent, until Babur’s victory at Panipat.
summary.zh: 马穆鲁克、卡尔吉、图格鲁克、赛义德和洛迪五个王朝相继以德里为都，抵御了蒙古人的进攻，在穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克时疆域几乎覆盖整个次大陆，直至巴布尔在帕尼帕特获胜。

sources.title: Peter Jackson, The Delhi Sultanate: A Political and Military History (1999)

summary.en: Founded by the brothers Harihara and Bukka on the Tungabhadra, Vijayanagara dominated south India for two centuries; its capital at Hampi astonished Persian and Portuguese visitors before the defeat at Talikota in 1565.
summary.zh: 毗奢耶那伽罗由诃里诃罗与布迦兄弟在栋格珀德拉河畔建立，称雄南印度两百年；其都城亨比曾令波斯与葡萄牙访客惊叹，1565年塔利科塔之败后衰落。

name.zh: 萨达湿婆·罗耶（摄政罗摩·罗阇）

sources.title: Burton Stein, Vijayanagara (New Cambridge History of India I.2, 1989)
UNESCO World Heritage List: Group of Monuments at Hampi

summary.en: Created by a revolt of Deccan nobles against Muhammad bin Tughluq, the Bahmani Sultanate ruled the northern Deccan, fought Vijayanagara and, after the minister Mahmud Gawan’s execution, split into five successor sultanates.
summary.zh: 巴赫曼尼苏丹国由德干贵族反叛穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克而建立，统治德干北部，与毗奢耶那伽罗长期交战；宰相马哈茂德·加万被处死后分裂为五个继承苏丹国。

sources.title: Richard M. Eaton, A Social History of the Deccan, 1300–1761 (2005)

capital.zh: 阿格拉；法塔赫布尔西格里；拉合尔；德里（沙贾汉纳巴德）

summary.en: Founded by the Timurid Babur, the Mughal Empire ruled most of South Asia by 1700, combining Persianate court culture with a vast revenue system; after Aurangzeb it fragmented, and the British deposed the last emperor in 1857.
summary.zh: 莫卧儿帝国由帖木儿后裔巴布尔创建，至1700年已统治南亚大部，融合波斯化宫廷文化与庞大的税收体系；奥朗则布之后帝国分崩离析，1857年英国废黜末代皇帝。

sources.title: John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)

note: Humayun was in exile 1540–1555 during the Sur interregnum.

capital.zh: 赖格尔；萨塔拉；浦那（佩什瓦）

summary.en: From Shivaji’s hill-fort kingdom the Marathas expanded under the Peshwas into a confederacy dominating much of India in the 18th century; checked at Panipat in 1761, they recovered, but defeat in the Anglo-Maratha wars ended their power in 1818.
summary.zh: 马拉塔人从希瓦吉的山堡王国起家，在佩什瓦领导下扩张为18世纪称雄印度大部的联盟；1761年帕尼帕特之败使其受挫，此后虽有恢复，但英马战争的失败使其势力于1818年终结。

name.zh: 马达夫拉奥一世（佩什瓦）

sources.title: Stewart Gordon, The Marathas 1600–1818 (New Cambridge History of India II.4, 1993)

capital.zh: 迈索尔；斯里兰加帕特纳

summary.en: A Wodeyar kingdom that began as a Vijayanagara vassal, Mysore became a major military power under Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan; after 1799 the restored Wodeyars ruled it as a princely state until it joined India.
summary.zh: 迈索尔原为毗奢耶那伽罗属下的沃迪亚尔王国，在海德尔·阿里和蒂普苏丹时期成为军事强国；1799年后复辟的沃迪亚尔王室以土邦形式统治，直至并入印度。

name.zh: 克里希纳罗阇·沃迪亚尔三世

sources.title: Kate Brittlebank, Tipu Sultan’s Search for Legitimacy (1997)

note: The 1399 founding is traditional; the state was integrated into India in 1947–1950.

summary.en: Ranjit Singh unified the Sikh misls into a Punjab state stretching from the Khyber Pass to Kashmir; after his death succession struggles weakened it, and two wars with the British ended in annexation in 1849.
summary.zh: 兰吉特·辛格将锡克各米斯尔统一为从开伯尔山口延伸至克什米尔的旁遮普国家；他死后王位之争削弱了国力，与英国的两次战争后于1849年被吞并。

sources.title: J. S. Grewal, The Sikhs of the Punjab (New Cambridge History of India II.3, 1990)

note: Dated from Ranjit Singh’s capture of Lahore (1799); Wikidata’s inception of 1733 refers to earlier Sikh confederacies.

summary.en: After the 1857 rebellion the British Crown took over the East India Company’s territories, ruling directly or through some 560 princely states until independence and partition in 1947.
summary.zh: 1857年起义后英国王室接管东印度公司领地，通过直接统治或约560个土邦进行间接统治，直至1947年印巴独立与分治。

name.zh: 维多利亚女王（1876年起兼印度女皇）

sources.title: Barbara D. Metcalf & Thomas R. Metcalf, A Concise History of Modern India, 3rd ed. (2012)

summary.en: Independent in 1947 and a republic from 1950, India is the world’s most populous democracy, a federal union of states organised largely on linguistic lines.
summary.zh: 印度1947年独立，1950年成为共和国，是世界上人口最多的民主国家，由大体按语言划分的各邦组成联邦。

name.zh: 贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁（总理）
阿塔尔·比哈里·瓦杰帕伊（总理）

note: “to” is the atlas end year; the state continues. Indira Gandhi also served 1980–1984.

capital.zh: 卡拉奇（至1959年）；伊斯兰堡（1967年起）

summary.en: Created in 1947 as a homeland for South Asia’s Muslims in two wings, Pakistan lost its eastern wing when Bangladesh became independent in 1971 and has alternated between civilian and military rule.
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦于1947年作为南亚穆斯林的家园建立，分为东西两翼；1971年东翼独立为孟加拉国，此后国家在文官与军人统治之间交替。

name.zh: 穆罕默德·阿里·真纳（总督）

sources.title: Ian Talbot, Pakistan: A New History (2012)

note: “to” is the atlas end year; the state continues.

summary.en: Formerly East Pakistan, Bangladesh declared independence on 26 March 1971 and won it after a nine-month war; it is one of the world’s most densely populated countries.
summary.zh: 孟加拉国原为东巴基斯坦，1971年3月26日宣布独立，经九个月战争取得独立，是世界上人口最稠密的国家之一。

sources.title: Willem van Schendel, A History of Bangladesh (2009)

note: “to” is the atlas end year; the state continues. Sheikh Hasina also served 1996–2001.

capital.zh: 科伦坡；斯里贾亚瓦德纳普拉科特（1982年起）

summary.en: Independent as the Dominion of Ceylon in 1948, the island became the Republic of Sri Lanka in 1972; its politics were long shaped by Sinhala–Tamil tensions and the civil war of 1983–2009.
summary.zh: 该岛于1948年以锡兰自治领身份独立，1972年成为斯里兰卡共和国；其政治长期受僧伽罗人与泰米尔人之间的矛盾以及1983—2009年内战影响。

name.zh: 西丽玛沃·班达拉奈克（总理）

sources.title: K. M. de Silva, A History of Sri Lanka, rev. ed. (2005)

note: Wikidata’s Q854 starts in 1972 (republic); 1948–1972 is the Dominion of Ceylon (Q2670092). “to” is the atlas end year.

name.zh: 西部总督（西方沙特拉普）

summary.en: Saka (Indo-Scythian) rulers who held Gujarat, Malwa and the western Deccan for almost four centuries, first as Kushan governors and then independently. Their dated silver coins give one of the most precise dynastic chronologies of ancient India.
summary.zh: 塞种（印度-斯基泰）统治者，先后作为贵霜总督和独立君主统治古吉拉特、马尔瓦和德干西部近四百年。他们标有纪年的银币为古印度提供了最精确的王朝年表之一。

name.zh: 纳哈帕纳（克沙哈拉塔家族）

sources.title: Upinder Singh, A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India (2008), ch. 8

note: Early reigns are dated by the Shaka era (78 CE) and overlap; Nahapana belongs to the rival Kshaharata house that Gautamiputra Satakarni overthrew c. 124. Rudrasimha III was defeated by Chandragupta II c. 395–405.

capital.zh: 南迪瓦尔达纳（纳加尔丹）与瓦察古尔玛（瓦希姆）

summary.en: The leading Deccan power of the Gupta age, allied to the Guptas through the marriage of Prabhavatigupta, daughter of Chandragupta II. The Vatsagulma branch under Harishena patronised the later caves of Ajanta.
summary.zh: 笈多时代德干地区的主要政权，通过旃陀罗笈多二世之女波罗婆婆蒂笈多的婚姻与笈多王朝结盟。其瓦察古尔玛支系的诃利希纳王赞助了阿旃陀后期石窟。

name.zh: 诃利希纳（瓦察古尔玛支系）

sources.title: Hans T. Bakker, The Vakatakas: An Essay in Hindu Iconology (1997)
Walter M. Spink, Ajanta: History and Development, vol. 1 (2005)

note: Regnal years are approximate reconstructions from copper-plate grants that give regnal years but no era.

summary.en: One of the three crowned Tamil kingdoms of the Sangam poems, ruling the far south from Madurai. After a revival from the late 6th century and a second, imperial peak in the 13th century, Pandya power broke under the Khalji raid of 1311 and the Madurai Sultanate.
summary.zh: 桑伽姆诗歌中的泰米尔“三冠王”之一，以马杜赖为都统治印度最南端。6世纪末复兴，13世纪迎来第二次帝国鼎盛；1311年卡尔吉军队南侵及马杜赖苏丹国建立后，潘地亚势力瓦解。

name.zh: 阿里凯萨里·马拉瓦尔曼
贾塔瓦尔曼·孙达拉·潘地亚一世
马拉瓦尔曼·库拉塞卡拉一世

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, The Pandyan Kingdom (1929)
Noboru Karashima (ed.), A Concise History of South India (2014)

note: The Pandyas are attested from the 3rd century BCE (Ashoka’s edicts); the band starts at the atlas floor of 50 BCE. Marco Polo visited the Pandya coast in the 1290s.

capital.zh: 万吉（卡鲁尔）；后为马霍达亚普拉姆（科东格阿卢尔）

summary.en: The Sangam-age kingdom of the Malabar coast and Kongu country, whose pepper ports such as Muziris traded with Rome. A later line, the Chera Perumals of Mahodayapuram, ruled Kerala from the 9th to the early 12th century.
summary.zh: 桑伽姆时代统治马拉巴尔海岸与孔古地区的王国，其穆济里斯等胡椒港与罗马通商。后起的马霍达亚普拉姆哲罗·佩鲁马尔王朝自9世纪统治喀拉拉至12世纪初。

name.zh: 斯塔努·拉维·库拉塞卡拉
巴斯卡拉·拉维·瓦尔曼一世
拉玛·库拉塞卡拉（末代佩鲁马尔）

sources.title: M. G. S. Narayanan, Perumāḷs of Kerala (1972; rev. 2013)

note: Sangam-era Chera chronology is uncertain; the 9th–12th-century Perumal dates follow M. G. S. Narayanan. There is a gap in the record between the two lines.

summary.en: The first great Sinhalese kingdom, centred on the sacred city of Anuradhapura with its giant stupas, monasteries and irrigation tanks. It was a hub of Theravada Buddhism until Chola armies sacked the capital and carried off King Mahinda V in 1017.
summary.zh: 僧伽罗人的第一个大王国，以拥有巨型佛塔、寺院和灌溉水库的圣城阿努拉德普勒为中心。它一直是上座部佛教的中心，直到1017年朱罗军队洗劫都城并掳走国王摩哂陀五世。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Sacred City of Anuradhapura
K. M. de Silva, A History of Sri Lanka (1981; rev. 2005)

note: Founded by tradition in 377 BCE (Pandukabhaya); the band starts at the atlas floor. Reign dates follow Wilhelm Geiger’s chronology of the Mahavamsa and Culavamsa.

capital.zh: 加德满都谷地（马纳格里哈，近德奥帕坦）

summary.en: The first historically documented dynasty of the Kathmandu Valley, known from some 200 Sanskrit inscriptions. Licchavi kings built temples and water spouts and controlled a trade route between India and Tibet; Amshuverma married his daughter, by Tibetan tradition, to Songtsen Gampo.
summary.zh: 加德满都谷地第一个有史可考的王朝，留下约200通梵文碑铭。李查维国王修建神庙与石砌水槽，掌控印度与吐蕃之间的商道；据藏族传说，鸯输伐摩将女儿嫁给了松赞干布。

sources.title: Mary Shepherd Slusser, Nepal Mandala: A Cultural Study of the Kathmandu Valley (1982)

note: No single Wikidata item cleanly covers the Licchavi state. The first dated inscription (Changu Narayan, 464) opens the documented record; the dynasty faded in the later 8th century, with the end date variously put between 750 and 879.

name.zh: 普西亚布蒂（伐弹那）王朝

capital.zh: 萨他泥湿伐罗（塔内萨尔），后为曲女城（卡瑙季）

summary.en: A north Indian house that rose at Thanesar after the Gupta collapse and peaked under Harsha, who ruled from Kannauj and hosted the pilgrim Xuanzang. The dynasty ended with Harsha’s death without an heir in 647.
summary.zh: 笈多衰落后在塔内萨尔兴起的北印度王族，在戒日王时达到鼎盛，戒日王定都曲女城并接待了玄奘。647年戒日王无嗣而终，王朝随之结束。

sources.title: Bana, Harshacharita, tr. E. B. Cowell & F. W. Thomas (1897)

note: The founding generations are known only from Bana’s Harshacharita and seals; 500 is an approximate start.

name.zh: 瞿折罗-普罗蒂哈拉王朝

summary.en: Rulers from western India who checked the Arab advance from Sindh in the 8th century and then fought the Palas and Rashtrakutas for Kannauj. Under Mihira Bhoja the empire stretched from Gujarat to Bengal; Mahmud of Ghazni’s sack of Kannauj in 1018 broke it.
summary.zh: 来自印度西部的王朝，8世纪遏制了阿拉伯人从信德的推进，随后与波罗、罗湿陀罗拘陀争夺曲女城。在米希拉·博贾治下，帝国从古吉拉特延伸到孟加拉；1018年伽色尼的马哈茂德洗劫曲女城，使其瓦解。

sources.title: Baij Nath Puri, The History of the Gurjara-Pratiharas (1957)

name.zh: 卡利亚尼西遮娄其王朝

capital.zh: 马尼亚凯塔，后为卡利亚尼（巴萨瓦卡利扬）

summary.en: A Chalukya revival that overthrew the Rashtrakutas in 973 and ruled the western Deccan for two centuries, in near-constant war with the Cholas. The court of Vikramaditya VI produced Bilhana’s poetry and the legal commentary Mitakshara.
summary.zh: 遮娄其王族的复兴，973年推翻罗湿陀罗拘陀，统治德干西部两个世纪，几乎不断与朱罗交战。超日王六世的宫廷孕育了比尔哈纳的诗作和法典注疏《密塔克沙拉》。

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, A History of South India (1955)

capital.zh: 贝鲁尔，后为多拉萨穆德拉（哈莱比都）

summary.en: A Kannada dynasty from the Malnad hills that became the leading power of the southern Deccan in the 12th–13th centuries, famous for star-shaped soapstone temples at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura. Khalji and Tughluq raids and the death of Veera Ballala III in 1343 ended it.
summary.zh: 源自马尔纳德山区的卡纳达王朝，12至13世纪成为南德干的主导力量，以贝鲁尔、哈莱比都和索马纳塔普拉的星形皂石神庙闻名。卡尔吉、图格鲁克军队的入侵以及1343年维拉·巴拉拉三世之死终结了王朝。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas
J. Duncan M. Derrett, The Hoysalas (1957)

summary.en: Former Chalukya vassals who united the Telugu-speaking lands, built tanks that still irrigate Telangana and raised the Thousand Pillar and Ramappa temples. Queen Rudrama Devi ruled in her own right; Warangal fell to the Delhi Sultanate in 1323.
summary.zh: 原为遮娄其的附庸，统一了泰卢固语地区，修建的水库至今仍灌溉着特伦甘纳，并建造了千柱神庙和拉玛帕神庙。女王鲁德拉玛·德维以本人名义执政；1323年瓦朗加尔被德里苏丹国攻陷。

sources.title: Cynthia Talbot, Precolonial India in Practice: Society, Region, and Identity in Medieval Andhra (2001)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kakatiya Rudreshwara (Ramappa) Temple

note: Independence is usually dated to Rudradeva’s Hanamkonda inscription of 1163.

summary.en: The Sinhalese kingdom founded when Vijayabahu I drove out the Cholas (1070) and kept their former provincial capital. Under Parakramabahu I it unified the island, built vast reservoirs and sent armies to south India and Burma, before invasions by Kalinga Magha broke it.
summary.zh: 维阇耶巴忽一世驱逐朱罗人（1070年）后建立的僧伽罗王国，沿用了朱罗人的省会。在波罗迦罗摩巴忽一世治下统一全岛，修建大型水库并向南印度和缅甸派兵，后在羯陵伽·摩伽的入侵下瓦解。

name.zh: 莉拉瓦蒂（女王，三度在位）

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Ancient City of Polonnaruwa

note: Vijayabahu ruled from Ruhuna from 1055 and took Polonnaruwa in 1070. Lilavati reigned in three short spells between 1197 and 1212.

summary.en: An independent sultanate formed when Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah united Bengal in 1352. Rich from rice, textiles and the Bay of Bengal trade, it exchanged embassies with Ming China, patronised Bengali literature and built brick mosques with curved cornices, until Akbar’s armies annexed it.
summary.zh: 1352年沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙统一孟加拉后形成的独立苏丹国。依靠稻米、纺织和孟加拉湾贸易致富，与明朝互派使节，赞助孟加拉语文学，建造带弧形檐口的砖砌清真寺，最终被阿克巴的军队吞并。

sources.title: Richard M. Eaton, The Rise of Islam and the Bengal Frontier, 1204–1760 (1993)

note: Ilyas Shah ruled western Bengal from 1342 and unified the province in 1352.

summary.en: The Afghan empire of Sher Shah Suri, who drove Humayun out of India in 1540. In fifteen years the Surs rebuilt the Grand Trunk Road, standardised the silver rupiya and reorganised land revenue; Akbar’s victory at Panipat in 1556 restored the Mughals.
summary.zh: 舍尔沙·苏尔建立的阿富汗人帝国，1540年将胡马雍逐出印度。苏尔王朝在十五年间重修大干道、统一银币卢比并改革田赋；1556年阿克巴在帕尼帕特获胜，莫卧儿王朝复辟。

name.zh: 阿迪勒·沙·苏尔（大将赫穆）

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Sher Shah of Sur
Iqtidar Alam Khan, ‘The Sur dynasty’, in The Cambridge Economic History of India, vol. 1 (1982)

name.zh: 戈尔康达苏丹国（库特布·沙希王朝）

capital.zh: 戈尔康达，后为海得拉巴

summary.en: One of the five Deccan sultanates that grew out of the Bahmani state. Its Persian-speaking kings patronised Telugu, founded Hyderabad in 1591 and grew rich on diamonds from the Krishna valley mines, until Aurangzeb took Golconda after an eight-month siege in 1687.
summary.zh: 由巴赫曼尼苏丹国分裂出的德干五苏丹国之一。讲波斯语的国王们赞助泰卢固语文化，于1591年建海得拉巴，并借克里希纳河谷的钻石矿致富；1687年奥朗则布围城八个月后攻陷戈尔康达。

name.zh: 苏丹·库利·库特布·穆尔克
易卜拉欣·库利·库特布·沙
穆罕默德·库利·库特布·沙
阿布勒·哈桑·库特布·沙（塔纳·沙）

sources.title: Richard M. Eaton, A Social History of the Deccan, 1300–1761 (2005)
H. K. Sherwani, History of the Qutb Shahi Dynasty (1974)

capital.zh: 查莱德奥，后为加尔冈和朗布尔（锡布萨加尔）

summary.en: A Tai kingdom founded by Sukaphaa in the upper Brahmaputra valley that ruled Assam for six centuries, kept detailed court chronicles (buranjis) and repeatedly turned back Mughal invasions. Burmese invasions and the Treaty of Yandabo (1826) brought it under British rule.
summary.zh: 由苏卡法在布拉马普特拉河上游建立的傣族王国，统治阿萨姆六个世纪，留下详尽的宫廷编年史“布兰吉”，并多次击退莫卧儿军队。缅甸入侵和1826年《杨达波条约》使其归于英国统治。

sources.title: Edward Gait, A History of Assam (1906; rev. 1926)

summary.en: The last independent Sinhalese kingdom, protected by the central highlands, which outlasted Portuguese and Dutch control of the coasts. Its kings guarded the Tooth Relic; from 1739 the throne passed to the Nayakkar line from south India, and the British annexed it in 1815.
summary.zh: 最后一个独立的僧伽罗王国，凭借中部山地的屏障，挺过了葡萄牙和荷兰对沿海的控制。国王守护佛牙舍利；1739年起王位传入来自南印度的纳亚卡尔家族，1815年被英国吞并。

name.zh: 维摩罗达摩苏利耶一世
室利·维克拉马·罗阇辛哈（末代）

sources.title: K. M. de Silva, A History of Sri Lanka (1981; rev. 2005), chs. 9–13
Lorna Dewaraja, The Kandyan Kingdom of Sri Lanka 1707–1782 (1988)

note: The Kandyan state emerged as a sub-kingdom of Kotte in the 1470s and became fully independent under Vimaladharmasuriya I (1590).

capital.en: Bhaktapur; from 1482 also Kantipur (Kathmandu) and Patan
capital.zh: 巴克塔普尔；1482年后亦有坎提普尔（加德满都）和帕坦

summary.en: The Newar kings of the Kathmandu Valley, whose rival courts at Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur filled their Durbar Squares with pagoda temples, palaces and festivals. Jayasthiti Malla codified caste law; Yaksha Malla’s division of the realm left it open to Gorkha conquest in 1768–69.
summary.zh: 加德满都谷地的尼瓦尔国王。加德满都、帕坦、巴克塔普尔三座相互竞争的王廷在各自的杜巴广场上兴建了宝塔式神庙、宫殿并举行节庆。贾亚斯提蒂·马拉编订种姓法；亚克沙·马拉分割国土，使其在1768–1769年被廓尔喀征服。

name.zh: 普拉塔普·马拉（坎提普尔）
贾亚·普拉卡什·马拉（坎提普尔，末代）

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Kathmandu Valley

note: Bhaktapur, the last Malla kingdom, fell in 1769; Wikidata’s end date (1779) is not supported by the standard histories.

summary.en: The Himalayan kingdom forged by Prithvi Narayan Shah’s conquest of the Kathmandu Valley. From 1846 to 1951 hereditary Rana prime ministers held real power; restored royal rule, the 2001 palace massacre and a Maoist insurgency ended in the abolition of the monarchy in 2008.
summary.zh: 由普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿征服加德满都谷地而建立的喜马拉雅王国。1846至1951年间世袭的拉纳家族首相掌握实权；王权恢复后，经历2001年王宫惨案和毛派武装斗争，君主制于2008年被废除。

name.zh: 忠格·巴哈杜尔·拉纳（首相）

sources.title: John Whelpton, A History of Nepal (2005)

note: Tribhuvan was briefly displaced in 1950–51 by his grandson Gyanendra, who was enthroned again in 2001.

summary.en: The Drukpa state founded by the Tibetan lama Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal, who arrived in 1616 and unified the valleys under a dual system of religious and civil rule. The Wangchuck hereditary monarchy began in 1907 and became constitutional in 2008.
summary.zh: 由藏传佛教竹巴噶举派喇嘛夏仲·阿旺朗杰建立的国家。他于1616年来到不丹，以政教二元体制统一各河谷。旺楚克世袭君主制始于1907年，2008年转为君主立宪制。

name.zh: 吉格梅·凯萨尔·纳姆耶尔·旺楚克

sources.title: Karma Phuntsho, The History of Bhutan (2013)
Michael Aris, The Raven Crown: The Origins of Buddhist Monarchy in Bhutan (1994)

note: Covers the Bhutanese state from the Zhabdrung’s arrival (1616); the QID is the present country.

summary.en: The island monarchy that converted to Islam in 1153 and ruled the atolls from Malé for eight centuries, exporting cowrie shells used as money from Bengal to West Africa. It survived a brief Portuguese occupation (1558–73) and British protection (1887–1965) and became a republic in 1968.
summary.zh: 1153年皈依伊斯兰教的岛国君主制，以马累为中心统治群岛八个世纪，出口的宝贝壳在孟加拉至西非一带被用作货币。它经历了短暂的葡萄牙占领（1558–1573年）和英国保护（1887–1965年），1968年成为共和国。

name.zh: 穆罕默德·阿迪勒（多维米）
穆罕默德·法里德·迪迪（末代）

sources.title: Clarence Maloney, People of the Maldive Islands (1980)
Ibn Battuta, Rihla, tr. H. A. R. Gibb & C. F. Beckingham, vol. IV (1994)

note: The conversion date of 1153 (548 AH) comes from later Maldivian chronicles (Tarikh). Khadijah reigned in three spells between 1347 and 1380.

name.zh: 海得拉巴土邦（阿萨夫·贾希王朝尼扎姆）

capital.zh: 奥兰加巴德，后为海得拉巴（1763年起）

summary.en: Founded by the Mughal viceroy Asaf Jah I, who made the Deccan his own after 1724. As the largest princely state of British India it kept its own currency, army and railways; India annexed it in September 1948 in a police action (Operation Polo).
summary.zh: 由莫卧儿德干总督阿萨夫·贾一世于1724年后自立建立。作为英属印度最大的土邦，拥有自己的货币、军队和铁路；1948年9月印度以“警察行动”（马球行动）将其兼并。

name.zh: 阿萨夫·贾一世（尼扎姆·乌尔·穆尔克）
尼扎姆·阿里·汗（阿萨夫·贾二世）

name.en: Mir Osman Ali Khan (Asaf Jah VII)
name.zh: 米尔·奥斯曼·阿里·汗（阿萨夫·贾七世）

sources.title: Benjamin B. Cohen, Kingship and Colonialism in India’s Deccan, 1850–1948 (2007)
